## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes (backend) and `npm test` passes (frontend, if touched)
- [ ] `make lint` is clean; `npm run typecheck` is clean (frontend, if touched)
- [ ] New or changed FSM transitions and prohibitions have their own tests
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] A new architectural decision has an ADR in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or employment-domain wording
